'''Cube v7 + Objectives Draft''' is a draft format on [[GEMP]] in which each player first picks two objective packs per side and then drafts 54 cards from a cube list. GEMP's draft list points this type to <code>/draft/cubeObj7Draft.json</code>.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="drafts" /><ref name="c7o" />

* '''Type:''' booster draft (GEMP cube draft)
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee Cube page; GEMP draft file
* '''Card pool:''' a Cube version 7 list with objective packs; 2 objective picks and 54 card picks per side, no fixed cards
* '''In use:''' unknown
* '''GEMP:''' ''Cube v7 + Objectives Draft'' (<code>c7obj_draft</code>) on play.swccg.com; on the Players Committee GEMP the same draft file is played under the [[Cube]] format<ref name="pc-c7o" />

== Card pool ==
The draft has no fixed cards. For each side a player makes two objective picks from 15 objective packs, then 54 normal picks from a list of 262 Light Side or 259 Dark Side cards.<ref name="c7o" /> In an objective pick each choice is a whole pack, shown by its first card: the first pick offers two packs and the second offers one, and the player gets every card in the chosen pack. The packs have 8 to 25 cards each.<ref name="dcb" /><ref name="c7o" />

=== How picks work ===
GEMP shuffles each side's pick list and offers a shrinking "pack": 9 cards, then 8, down to 1, then 9 again, six times over 54 picks. A card already in the player's pool is not offered again, and a picked card brings any add-on cards listed for it.<ref name="dcb" /><ref name="c7o" />

=== Deck rules ===
On play.swccg.com the format sets a deck size of 40 cards and is not a game hall format.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib" /> The Players Committee code's draft file names its <code>cube</code> format instead, which sets 45 cards.<ref name="pc-c7o" /><ref name="pc-gemp" /> The format's set list is the same as [[Open]]; the drafted pool limits what a player can use.<ref name="gemp" />

== History ==
The Players Committee Cube page links older cubes, versions 1 to 7, from 2014 to 2020, but does not describe this draft.<ref name="pc-cube" /> GEMP's draft list also keeps two Cube v7 drafts marked legacy, <code>c7_draft</code> and <code>c7revised_draft</code>.<ref name="drafts" /> The Players Committee GEMP code has the same draft file under its Cube format; play.swccg.com gave it its own format.<ref name="pc-c7o" /><ref name="c7o" /><ref name="gemp" /> No source gives who built it or when, and no event result is recorded.
